headline: "ElKat" designated sole operator of international internet traffic in Kyrgyzstan
summary: The Kyrgyz cabinet designated ElKat as the only operator for delivering, transiting and transferring international internet traffic across Kyrgyzstan.
why: Exclusive control of international internet gateways gives one operator a dominant position in national telecom infrastructure and affects competing providers.
original_headline: «ЭлКат» определили единственным оператором международного интернет-трафика в КР
